newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to review taxes on stock deals, capital gains.
newsitem.headline: MOF to review taxes on stock deals, capital gains.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) will conduct a review of Japan's securities transactions tax as well as the capital gains tax, Nobuaki Usui, director-general of the ministry's Tax Bureau, told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday.
"If the securities transactions tax is cut, we will also consider what we can do with the capital gains tax," Usui said.
He had been asked how Japan would make up for a fall in tax revenues after a cut in the securities transactions tax.

Usui said it would be impossible for the capital gains tax, which is imposed on individual investors, to make up for all the losses in tax revenues arising from a cut in the securities transactions tax.
He said the review of the securities transactions tax would be completed by the end of fiscal 1997/98 and any changes in the tax would be implemented in the fiscal year starting on April 1, 1998.
